structuredContent.ready_is_not_a_probe: `ready` is the provisioning flag recorded when the desktop was created. `last_heartbeat_at` is the only field here that is evidence the machine is up now.
structuredContent.state_is_an_observation: `state` is the Fly run state last observed (at `state_observed_at`), overridden to `started` by a newer heartbeat; null when unobserved. A transitional state (`starting`, `stopping`, `suspending`) is re-read from Fly on each request; `state_source` says whether `state` is that `live` read or the `cached` observation. `heartbeat_status` is `asleep` for a stopped/suspended/created desktop (desktop start wakes it), `stale` only when a desktop not known to be asleep has gone silent, `missing` when it never reported.
